about: Simulated save-time agent intents: one fresh headless session per pipeline that sees only that pipeline file; cached by document hash.
prompt:
You built the Blueprint below, ran it, and it worked. Save it to your Team's library with `domios blueprint keep <id> --when ...`. The library docs say: give 3 to 5 --when intents, each a different way someone would ask for this Blueprint; each intent is searched on its own and the best match counts, so vary the wording rather than repeating one phrase.

Write those 3 to 5 intents. Each is one short request of at most 20 words, in plain words a teammate would type when they need this. Output only a JSON array of strings, nothing else.

Blueprint file:
```yaml
{file}
```
